items.title: Article I — Appropriations, fiscal limitations and oversight

stages.title: 01 / Constitutional provision
stages.note: Congressional fiscal powers and the constitutional restriction on drawing Treasury money.

stages.title: 02 / Constitutional actor
stages.note: Congress is the legislative actor; House and Senate roles are separate and not Treasury operational chains.

stages.title: 03 / Statutory legal and fiscal limits
stages.note: General Title 31 fiscal laws do not themselves supply specific appropriations.

stages.title: 04 / Institutional execution context
stages.note: GAO is a legislative oversight actor; no specific agency obligating official is modeled.

stages.title: 05 / Bounded functional responsibility
stages.note: Purpose, availability and documentary safeguards; no real expenditure or spending actor certified.

stages.title: 06 / Oversight, qualifications and remedies
stages.note: No enacted account-level appropriation, obligation record or fiscal review determination certified.

items.title: Article II — President, civilian Defense leadership and conditional command

stages.title: 01 / Constitutional provision
stages.note: Commander in Chief and Take Care powers remain constitutionally bounded.

stages.title: 02 / Constitutional actor
stages.note: President has the Commander in Chief role; no specific military command order is evidenced.

stages.title: 03 / Enabling statute and judicial context
stages.note: Selected Title 10 text only; Youngstown provides comparative separation-of-powers doctrine, not a military-specific case ruling.

stages.title: 04 / Department and competent role
stages.note: Defense Department and SecDef are distinct; official appointment and individual delegation remain unverified.

stages.title: 05 / Statutory and candidate function
stages.note: Scoped civilian direction and conditionally arranged combatant command; no particular use of force authorized.

stages.title: 06 / Constitutional and operational restrictions
stages.note: Congressional oversight context and unresolved specific delegation, command-plan and judicial-scope reviews.

items.title: Article III — Jurisdiction, judicial review and case-specific remedies

stages.title: 01 / Constitutional provision
stages.note: Article III vesting, judicial subject matter, and Supreme Court jurisdiction are distinct provisions.

stages.title: 02 / Constitutional judicial actors
stages.note: District courts and the Supreme Court exercise differentiated judicial roles.

stages.title: 03 / Statutory jurisdiction and judicial doctrine
stages.note: Section 1331 original jurisdiction and §1254 review routes; Marbury and Lujan are judicial case law, not original clauses.

stages.title: 04 / Court institutions and review pathway
stages.note: Court of appeals category included; this does not supply appellate jurisdiction for a particular judgment.

stages.title: 05 / Bounded adjudicative functions
stages.note: Federal-question and certiorari/certification routes without a specific litigant or judgment.

stages.title: 06 / Adjudicative limits and remedies
stages.note: Standing, appellate review prerequisites, cause of action, sovereign immunity and available relief unresolved.
